ReasoningScratchPad: Investigating database timeout patterns and connectivity issues
Title: SQL Database Connection Timeout Issues
SystemDesignKnowledge: Azure SQL Database with application connectivity
InitialSymptoms: Application logs showing frequent timeout exceptions
SymptomsObserved: Database connection timeout errors, query timeout exceptions, intermittent connectivity failures
StepsFollowed:
1. Checked network connectivity
2. Reviewed firewall rules
3. Optimized long-running queries
4. Increased connection timeout settings
RootCause: Network latency and long-running queries causing timeouts
Pitfalls: Don't just increase timeouts - investigate and fix slow queries
